findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: repo_ai_policy, ens_resolve, chainlink_price, web_extract, domain_check, email_check, ai_extract, ai_classify, ai_embed, ai_image, policy · Private data: repo_ai_policy, erc8004_agent, token_transfers, wallet_snapshot, token_info, ens_resolve, erc20_allowance, token_risk, web_extract, domain_check, email_check, token_balances, tx_decode, address_transfers, ai_transcribe · Public sink: ens_resolve, token_risk, email_check, ai_extract, ai_classify, ai_embed, ai_transcribe, ai_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: repo_ai_policy, ens_resolve, chainlink_price, web_extract, domain_check, email_check, ai_extract, ai_classify, ai_embed, ai_image, policy · Private data: repo_ai_policy, erc8004_agent, token_transfers, wallet_snapshot, token_info, ens_resolve, erc20_allowance, token_risk, web_extract, domain_check, email_check, token_balances, tx_decode, address_transfers, ai_transcribe · Public sink: ens_resolve, token_risk, email_check, ai_extract, ai_classify, ai_embed, ai_transcribe, ai_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
